description: Find which documentation SETS exist whose NAME matches a substring (e.g. "python" → Python 3.x, "react" → React). Returns doc SETS, NOT their content — this does NOT look up a function/method/API name. To search inside a doc for an entry like "Array.map" or "fetch", use search_index (slug + query).

query.description: Substring of a documentation-set name, e.g. "javascript", "postgres".

name: search_docs
